description: This file is a shell script used to determine version information from various version control systems (like git or hg) or a version file, primarily for use in build or release processes within a project.

methods.name: try_version
methods.description: Checks for the existence of a 'version' file and reads its contents if available.

methods.name: try_git
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the current git revision or commit hash based on various input formats and repository state.

methods.name: try_hg
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the current Mercurial revision.
